items.title: Session persistence
items.text: Your terminals now survive Ghoztty itself. App updates, crashes, and force-quits no longer kill what's running: processes live in a background agent, and windows re-attach on relaunch with their layout, tabs, titles, and scrollback intact. After a reboot, sessions come back with their scrollback restored. On by default, with a `session-relaunch` setting to control whether relaunch is automatic or prompted.

items.title: Take your sessions with you
items.text: Browse sessions running on any of your machines from the Cmd-Shift-N chooser, resume one locally, or "Resume all" to bring over a whole machine's windows. A new `ghoztty +sessions` command lists live sessions from the CLI.

items.title: Sticky pane banners
items.text: Pin a note above any pane that survives scrolling and clears. Set via Cmd+R (multi-line editor), `ghoztty +set-banner`, or an OSC 7778 escape from inside the pane. Supports bold, italics, `code`, and clickable links.

items.title: Fixes
items.text: Cmd+V/C/X/A/Z now work in banner/rename dialogs; the CLI no longer crashes when run outside the app bundle; smoother Windows agent installs (no console window flashes during MSI setup).
